title: Warnings carry and screen edges stay readable
intent: Keep the Giant's throw audible and enemies at the screen edge or under HUD panels visible

evidence.description: whoosh -32 to -16 dB, death volume 0.8 to 1, vignette 0.75 to 0.45, panels 0.74 to 0.5
edge contrast 23 to 32, under the coin panel 10 to 20

constraints.statement: A sound that warns (sfx-whoosh) stays well above the ambience; it measured -16 dB loudest 100 ms against ambience at -28 to -42
Death sounds play at full volume, never quieter than a hit
Vignette reaches at most 0.45 alpha and starts past 55 percent of the screen height; HUD panels are at most 0.5 alpha
